method: Dicke + XY-mixer QAOA, p=2, Aer matrix_product_state simulator (default qubit layout: hour blocks one after the other)
parameter_source: COBYLA from a small grid of linear-ramp starts (src.quantum.qaoa.QAOARunner.optimize) on the Aer statevector simulator, run on scale_6x2 (10 qubits) and scale_8x2 (12 qubits). candidate optimised on scale_6x2: mean exact approximation ratio 0.797; candidate optimised on scale_8x2: mean exact approximation ratio 0.803. Kept the candidate from scale_8x2. The p=2 angles gamma=[-1.1949, -0.6938], beta=[0.2528, 0.1734] were then fixed and transferred unchanged to every instance, layout and bond dimension; there is no re-optimisation at larger sizes, so ratios on larger instances include transfer loss. The training instances are in-sample for the angles.

notes: approx_ratio is the mean over 512 shots with invalid samples scored 0, against the exact classical optimum in each plans file (brute force up to 20 qubits, MILP above). bond_dim null is the untruncated statevector reference (only up to 20 qubits). fidelity is |<exact|mps>|^2 of the final state against the statevector of the same compiled circuit (up to 20 qubits; null above). max_bond_dim_used and mps_memory_mb are read from the final MPS of each run (save_matrix_product_state). Aer 0.18.2 on Windows crashes or hangs on some circuits at bond dimension 2 or 4; such a point is retried once with the circuit routed to a line (nearest-neighbour gates only) (1 point(s) in this file needed it; see their notes). Per-point limit 120 s, total budget 1200 s; points that did not run carry no numbers. Simulator only: this curve shows how far a truncated classical simulation of the circuit can go, not a quantum advantage.
